product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.summary: The ICS Olivetti NetStrada with Pentium III and Xeon configurations recorded in equipment inventories.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.history: The Italian municipality of Oulx records an ICS Olivetti NetStrada 5600 dated October 2000. A 2006 audit documents twelve units on a Puerto Rican public agency’s network.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.architec: The inventories record different configurations. Oulx lists an additional 733 MHz Pentium III, and INPDAP identifies a unit with two Xeons and 2 GB of RAM.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.oulx-inv: Comune di Oulx, Rendiconto 2017, equipment inventory nos. 185 and 1576
product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.inpdap-i: INPDAP, technological inventory, tender 597 annex 6, p. 67
product.olivetti-netstrada-5600.ocpr-aud: Oficina del Contralor de Puerto Rico, TI-07-01, 31 August 2006, p. 5
